mostWorthwhile.text: The kidney-to-marrow connection was most worthwhile: the low-oxygen cue links an organ signal to red-cell maturation and circulation.

leastWorthwhile.text: Removing the bone was clear but brief; the result did little to explain how the cells remove matrix.

surprise.text: The kidney's role in signaling red-cell production was the most interesting connection. Erythropoietin is named on the initial board, though not in the result.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, although the available combinations made the sequence largely predetermined rather than a compatibility discovery.

continue.text: I would be somewhat interested in another chapter if it developed more connections like the kidney-to-marrow signal; the brief, mostly forced steps alone were less engaging.
